caption: “Hi, Mister! Scramble a Nut?” Laurence Freeman Peck. Harvard Lampoon 46.6 (December 17, 1903). p. 121.
alt: A pen-and-ink cartoon of a crowd of squirrels in a park mobbing a man of whom only his trouser legs and buttoned shoes show: they climb his legs, stand begging, perch on his boots and leap at him, under the caption "Hi, Mister! Scramble a Nut?"
